name: WF7 - Morning Report & Night Queue Processing

nodes.name: Trigger 8:05 AM CDMX (Process Queue)
nodes.notes: Fires 8:05 AM America/Mexico_City (workflow timezone setting). Processes each pending night_queue lead via TOMO auction.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  nq.id,
  nq.conversation_id,
  nq.source,
  nq.lead_phone,
  nq.lead_name,
  nq.property_id,
  nq.lead_email,
  nq.temperature,
  nq.bot_summary,
  nq.queued_at
FROM night_queue nq
WHERE nq.processed = FALSE
ORDER BY nq.queued_at;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_night_conversations,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'inmuebles24') AS from_inmuebles24,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'easybroker') AS from_easybroker,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'whatsapp_direct') AS from_whatsapp_direct
FROM conversations
WHERE arrived_during = 'night'
  AND created_at >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date;
SELECT whatsapp_number FROM agents WHERE agent_id = 'agent_manager' LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Send Report to Manager
nodes.notes: Sends the formatted morning report to the manager via Evolution API (WhatsApp).

parameters.query:
SELECT
  nq.id AS queue_id,
  nq.conversation_id,
  nq.source,
  nq.lead_phone,
  nq.lead_name,
  nq.property_id,
  nq.lead_email,
  nq.temperature,
  nq.bot_summary,
  nq.queued_at,
  c.property_public_id,
  COALESCE(pc.payload->>'title', c.current_property, nq.property_id) AS property_title,
  COALESCE(pc.payload->>'price', 'Precio por confirmar') AS property_price
FROM night_queue nq
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.conversation_id = nq.conversation_id
LEFT JOIN properties_cache pc ON pc.property_id = nq.property_id
WHERE nq.processed = FALSE
ORDER BY nq.queued_at;

UPDATE conversations
SET mode = 'pending_assignment'
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
  AND mode = 'night_queued'
RETURNING conversation_id, mode;

nodes.name: Call WF19: Lead Router
nodes.notes:
Calls WF3a (Auction Launcher) with the lead data.
WF3a expects: conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, property_id, property_title, property_price, assigned_agent_id

parameters.query:
UPDATE night_queue
SET processed = TRUE,
    processed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, conversation_id, processed_at;
SELECT whatsapp_number FROM agents WHERE agent_id = 'agent_manager' LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Send Confirmation to Manager
nodes.notes: Notifies manager that all night queue leads have been processed via TOMO auctions.

nodes.name: No Pending Leads (Skip)
nodes.notes: No leads in the night queue. Nothing to process.
